❤️Thank you for 230,000 visits.❤️

Planning and Development - Dealcat(@StudioDealcat)
Operations Assistant - dewpy(@rupy818)

Welcome to our emotionally-charged study cafe.

Choose your preferred seat and study comfortably.
You can freely use various seats and spaces.

Use the focus timer to immerse yourself more in your studies.
There is also a space available for use with friends.

In a comfortable lighting and quiet cafe atmosphere
Take a break or enjoy studying calmly.

This game is currently undergoing continuous updates.
New features and spaces will continue to be added in the future.
Please send us many suggestions through the in-game 'Contact Us' feature.

If you like the game, please give us a 'Like' and add it to your 'Favorites'. It helps us a lot with development! :)

※The interior design and furniture arrangement were based on observations of various real study cafes.
